purpose: Scores video annotation results against ground-truth ShuttleSet rally and stroke metadata, producing comparative metrics and diagnostics for calibration.

public_api.name: canonical_tolerance
public_api.role: Computes frame-tolerance threshold from fps for stroke-timing matching

public_api.name: load_fixture_arrays
public_api.role: Loads persisted numpy arrays (track, poses, masks) from fixture storage

public_api.name: load_gt_tables
public_api.role: Reads ground-truth CSV tables (shots master, homography, courts, resolution)

public_api.name: build_run_video_inputs
public_api.role: Assembles complete positional and keyword arguments for one run_video invocation

public_api.name: load_set_tables
public_api.role: Reads per-rally stroke metadata CSVs for each set in a fixture

public_api.name: reconcile_sets
public_api.role: Validates and matches predicted rally spans against ground truth; extracts winner and landing info

public_api.name: score_video
public_api.role: Scores detected rallies against ground truth; computes per-rally and aggregate metrics

public_api.name: flatten_metrics
public_api.role: Converts VideoScoring tuple into flat dict of scalar metric values

public_api.name: render_table
public_api.role: Formats scored metrics as human-readable text table with optional baseline references

public_api.name: run_fixture
public_api.role: End-to-end: loads fixture, runs annotator pipeline, scores result, writes diagnostics

public_api.name: write_rallies_csv
public_api.role: Exports RallyRow records to CSV file

public_api.name: write_geometric_verdicts_csv
public_api.role: Exports per-rally geometric-winner diagnostics to CSV

public_api.name: write_guard_diagnostics
public_api.role: Exports inpaint filter codes and rejection-rule diagnostics for one video

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point; processes all fixtures with --capture, --out, and --no-replay-mask options
